title: Where Does an On-Device Prescription Reader Lose Medications? A Frozen-Replay Study, from a 270M Language Model to a 2B Vision-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.18699v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-device models let a phone read a prescription without sending the photograph anywhere, but small models fail in ways that are hard to attribute: to the camera, the OCR, the model, or the rules around it. We study a phone-based pipeline that reads a prescription photograph with PaddleOCR, extracts medications with a 270M-parameter language model, and filters the result with a deterministic backstop before showing suggestions. Replaying identical frozen inputs through each configuration, with deterministic generation verified, we compare configurations with paired document-level intervals on 49 captures of 15 synthetic prescriptions (6 typed, 9 handwritten by one writer). Production recall is 8%, and 0 of 45 on handwriting. The backstop removes no correct medication and cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1. On handwriting nearly all medications never reach the model in readable form; on typed sheets the model mostly picks the wrong text.

translated_title: 端侧处方阅读器在哪里丢失药物信息？一项从270M参数语言模型到2B参数视觉-语言模型的冻结重放研究
translated_abstract: 端侧模型可以让手机在无需将照片发送到任何地方的情况下读取处方，但小型模型的失败难以归因：究竟是相机、OCR、模型本身，还是围绕模型的规则出了问题。我们研究了一条基于手机的流水线：使用PaddleOCR读取处方照片，用270M参数的语言模型提取药物信息，并在展示建议前通过一个确定性后备机制对结果进行过滤。通过向每个配置重放完全相同的冻结输入并验证生成的确定性，我们在15张合成处方（6张打印版、9张由同一书写者完成的手写版）的49次拍摄上，采用配对的文档级区间对各配置进行比较。生产配置的召回率仅为8%，手写处方45个药物中识别为0。后备机制没有删除任何正确的药物，并将不安全输出从45个降至1个。在手写处方上，几乎所有药物从未以可读形式到达模型；而在打印处方上，模型大多选择了错误的文本。
tldr: 本文通过冻结重放实验对端侧处方阅读流水线进行失败归因，发现生产配置召回率仅8%（手写处方为0%），主要瓶颈在于OCR未能以可读形式将药物文本传递给模型，而确定性后备机制可在不损失任何正确药物的前提下将不安全输出从45个降至1个。
en_tdlr: A frozen-replay attribution study of an on-device prescription reading pipeline reveals only 8% recall overall (0% on handwriting) with OCR as the main bottleneck, while a deterministic backstop cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1 without removing any correct medications.
